title: Things were falling apart in Mall World last night, boulders raining from the skies
content: I'm curious if anyone else dealt with giant boulders and chunks of concrete falling from the skies last night. I was in a normal "plaza" area that I usually visit and noticed some turmoil off in the mountains, all of the sudden it started to rain down giant stones and I had to tell people to take cover. Never had that one happen before.
